title: Deep-Cut Animation
theme: The underrated Disney animated movies only real fans remember
intro: [excited] Tonight we're digging deep into the Disney vault! Black Cauldron, Atlantis, Treasure Planet, The Emperor's New Groove. [laughs] If you know these, you're my kind of nerd.

art.prompt: An ancient underground film vault lit by a lantern, revealing a black cauldron, a crystal shard, a glowing golden map sphere, and a llama-shaped stone statue Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Prydain Perils
categories.intro: [whispers] Gather close. Our first category comes from Disney's darkest corner: 1985's The Black Cauldron. [gasps] Spooky stuff, folks.

art.prompt: A massive black iron cauldron glowing with eerie green smoke inside a dark stone castle crypt, thorny vines and flickering torches Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Taran is an assistant pig-keeper, and his pig Hen Wen has this special power.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is she can see the future! An oracle pig. Honestly, that's the most useful pet in Disney history.

clues.clue: This furry, apple-loving sidekick worries about his poor, tender head.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Gurgi! Munchings and crunchings, everybody.

clues.clue: This skeletal villain wants the cauldron so he can raise an army of the undead.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Horned King! He's still one of the scariest things Disney ever put on screen.

clues.clue: The Black Cauldron was the first Disney animated feature to get this MPAA rating.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is PG! [chuckles] Disney even trimmed some of the scariest scenes before release.

clues.clue: The Black Cauldron is based on The Chronicles of Prydain, a book series by this author.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Lloyd Alexander! His books drew on Welsh mythology. Total Disney nerd points for you.

categories.title: Lost Empire Logbook
categories.intro: [excited] Dive, dive, dive! Next up is 2001's Atlantis: The Lost Empire. Grab your submarine and your dictionary.

art.prompt: A giant steampunk submarine descending past glowing blue crystals into an underwater cavern with ancient sunken stone towers Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This young linguist from a museum leads the way to the lost city in Atlantis: The Lost Empire.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Milo Thatch! [chuckles] A museum nerd saves the day. Love to see it.

clues.clue: Atlantis is guarded by this huge robotic lobster-like machine that attacks the submarine.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Leviathan! Biggest seafood platter ever.

clues.clue: The expedition travels in this giant submarine, named after a hero of Greek myth.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Ulysses! It doesn't make it home. Spoiler. Sorry.

clues.clue: Mike Mignola, creator of this comic book hero, helped design the film's angular look.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Hellboy! That's why Atlantis looks so cool. Strong lines, strong shadows.

clues.clue: Linguist Marc Okrand created the Atlantean language. He also built this famous alien language for Star Trek.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Klingon! He speaks two made-up languages. I barely speak one real one.

categories.title: Solar Sailors
categories.intro: Hoist the solar sails! [excited] We're blasting off with 2002's Treasure Planet. Pirates in space. What's not to love?

art.prompt: A golden old-world sailing galleon with glowing solar sails flying through a purple nebula past a crescent space station Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Treasure Planet sets this Robert Louis Stevenson pirate novel in outer space.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Treasure Island! Same pirates, way more lasers.

clues.clue: This little pink blob can turn himself into almost anything.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Morph! Best pet in space. He even does impressions.

clues.clue: Jim Hawkins learns about life from this cyborg ship's cook.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is John Silver! [sighs] Is he a villain? Is he a dad? He's both. It's complicated.

clues.clue: Martin Short voices this scatterbrained robot who lost part of his memory.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is B.E.N.! Bio-Electronic Navigator. He forgot most things, but not how to talk.

clues.clue: Emma Thompson voices the cat-like commander of the RLS Legacy. Name her.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Captain Amelia! A captain with whiskers and a very sharp tongue.

categories.title: Pull the Lever, Kronk!
categories.intro: [laughs] Wrong lever! Our next category is 2000's The Emperor's New Groove. Boom, baby!

art.prompt: A secret jungle laboratory with bubbling colorful potion bottles, a big wooden lever on a stone wall, and a trapdoor over a crocodile pit Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Emperor Kuzco is turned into this animal when Yzma's poison turns out to be something else.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is a llama! Llama face. Mmm, nope.

clues.clue: Eartha Kitt voices this scary, scheming royal advisor.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Yzma! Scary beyond all reason.

clues.clue: John Goodman voices this kind village leader who helps the llama get home.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pacha! [chuckles] He's the nicest guy in any Disney movie. Fight me.

clues.clue: Kuzco wants to wipe out Pacha's village to build this summer getaway with a waterslide.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Kuzcotopia! A waterslide. He was going to destroy a whole village for a waterslide.

clues.clue: Before it was a comedy, this movie began as an epic musical with this title and songs by Sting.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Kingdom of the Sun! The whole messy remake is in the documentary The Sweatbox. True nerd points.

categories.title: Overlooked Objects
categories.intro: Time for some deeper deep cuts! I'll show you an object from an underrated Disney animated movie. You name the movie. [whispers] These ones are sneaky.

art.prompt: A dusty treasure shelf in a forgotten film vault holding a hamster ball, a hexagon of sky, a bowler hat, an eagle feather, and a hot dog cart model Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A clear plastic ball rolls along a highway. Name the 2008 movie.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Bolt! That's Rhino the hamster's ball. He's awesome. He knows he's awesome.

media.prompt: A clear plastic hamster ball rolling down an empty desert highway at sunset, tumbleweeds and a road sign without text Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A strange piece of the sky has fallen into a school yard. Name the 2005 movie.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Chicken Little! The sky is falling. Well, a small piece of it.

media.prompt: A glowing blue hexagonal panel painted like the daytime sky lying in the grass of a small-town school yard, an old bell tower nearby Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A sinister bowler hat floats in the air. Name the 2007 movie.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Meet the Robinsons! Doris the evil hat. Keep moving forward.

clues.clue: A giant golden feather lies near a trap in the Australian outback. Name the 1990 movie.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Rescuers Down Under! It was Disney's first animated sequel in theaters.

media.prompt: A giant golden eagle feather resting beside a rusty metal trap on red outback rock, Uluru-like cliffs and a huge blue sky Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A hot dog cart sits on a rainy New York street near a houseboat. Name the 1988 movie.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Oliver & Company! A kitten, a gang of dogs, and Billy Joel. Why should I worry?
